description: Yggdrasil address derivation test vector. Seed all-0x01, matches Rust ygg_addr_from_pubkey, C lichen_identity_ygg_addr_from_ed25519, and Python yggdrasil_address.
Zero pubkey vector verifying U/L bit clear in IID and Yggdrasil prefix.
Known vector from Yggdrasil official test suite (pubkey from Ed25519 test vector).
note: LICHEN IID = SHA-512(pubkey)[0:8] with U/L bit cleared

description: U/L bit forced clear: pubkey 0x02 repeated hashes to byte0=0xaa with U/L bit set. Verifies implementation clears the Universal/Local bit (0x02 mask).

ul_bit_test.note: SHA-512(pubkey)[0] = 0xaa, after clearing bit 1 = 0xa8. U/L bit (0x02) MUST be clear in final IID.

description: U/L bit already clear: pubkey 0x01 repeated where hash naturally has U/L bit clear, no transformation needed.

ul_bit_test.note: SHA-512(pubkey)[0] = 0x5c, bit 1 already clear, IID unchanged

name: iid_yggdrasil_binding_verification
description: Lower 64 bits of 02xx Yggdrasil address MUST equal IID from same Ed25519 pubkey (spec §6 security: prevents substitution attacks).

assertions.name: ygg_lower64_equals_iid
assertions.invariant: The IID forms the lower 64 bits of the Yggdrasil address, binding the cryptographic identity to the routable address.

assertions.name: no_independent_iid
assertions.description: IID cannot be chosen independently of pubkey
assertions.invariant: Any node claiming a 02xx address MUST prove ownership of the Ed25519 key that derives that IID.

name: iid_binding_mismatch_attack
description: Attacker cannot claim victim's IID without victim's privkey. Mismatched pubkey->IID->02xx is detectable.

expected.reason: IID derived from attacker pubkey does not match victim IID; TOFU/announce verification fails
